name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acromegaly_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acromegaly.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.
